name: Revival Reset
source:
Japan, Aichi Prefecture, Central Nagoya.
One day in July, just before the summer break, Yuuma Takise, an introvert student who was experiencing a solitary and gloomy high school life, encountered a strange creature named Belb.
He could float, slip through walls, and even make things appear out of thin air... Belb, who nonchalantly showed off these strange powers, asked Yuuma to search for a certain game cartridge.
Just what was on this game cartridge--?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/558010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
日本愛知縣名古屋市中心。
七月的一天，暑假前夕，性格內向、過著孤獨陰鬱高中生活的瀧瀨悠馬遇見了一隻名叫Belb的奇怪生物。
它會漂浮、穿牆，甚至能憑空讓物品出現……Belb若無其事地展示著這些奇異能力，同時要求悠馬幫忙尋找某一盒遊戲卡帶。

這盒遊戲卡帶裡究竟有什麼——？

（來源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/558010/]Steam[/url]）
